observations.detail: npm install -g @nitrosend/cli completed in ~2s and installed 0.3.9; nitrosend --version prints 0.3.9, matching the version this docs page is generated from.

nitrosend login --api-key <key> --no-browser stored profile 'default'; nitrosend whoami --json reports auth=api_key, source=profile, apiUrl=https://api.nitrosend.com/mcp. NITROSEND_API_KEY env auth also works (source=env).

Authorization header value format differs between tokens: the signup response-header token works bare (200), while the API secret_key returns 401 {"code":401,"message":"Not authenticated"} unless prefixed with 'Bearer ' (then 200). Neither doc states the rule.
Docs say the bare `nitrosend` dashboard renders the envelope's blockers and next_action fields, but `nitrosend status --json` emits neither key; data carries issues[] and recommendations[] instead.
No CLI command wraps POST /v1/my/brands/<sid>/prepare_sending. The command reference lists no brand/prepare-sending subcommand, so headless sender activation needs raw HTTP between login and send.
Receipt page renders publisher 'nitrosend', service 'cli.send', occurred 2026-10-21T15:35:30.103Z — matching the CLI's 'Created at 2026-10-21 15:35:26 UTC' queue time for message id 5160978.
